positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
•	Oversaw inbound and outbound ocean freights, inputted and updated entries daily into freight management system, communicated with carriers and airlines to ensure timely arrivals, generated alert systems to notify clients of shipment arrival, assisted with staff projects and performed clerical functions, i.e. screening calls, scheduling, copying, mailing, faxing, filing, coordinating meetings, travel arrangements
•	Maintained inventory of office supplies to ensure optimal levels

positions.title: Executive Assistant to Managing Director of Technology
positions.description:
•	Acted as liaison between the Managing Director of Technology and other executives, managed and monitored project statuses of a twelve-person team to ensure deadlines were met and tasks were delegated appropriately, assisted in design initiatives such as creating e-blasts and promotional ads, and performed administrative tasks including screening calls, filing monthly expense reports, scheduling internal and external meetings and coordinating travel arrangements in a timely manner
•	Coordinated purchase orders and deliveries with requesting parties as well as managed a petty cash fund of $2000 for corporate office by safeguarding and verifying funds daily

positions.title: Technical Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
•	Provided executive support to CEO by screening calls, managing files and calendars, coordinating meetings and organizing office for efficiency
•	Initiated new project management protocol via Teamwork Project Management to better monitor and prioritize projects weekly
•	Updated the CRM system and co-project managed web development projects
•	Created creative sales specials and promotional ads using Photoshop and Illustrator in order to increase publicity by attracting clients and customers
